measurement.name: South Atlantic Current
measurement.width_metric_label: Southern component band breadth; total SAC width unknown
measurement.range_interpretation: Nominal source-reported local band breadth; no distribution, confidence interval, seasonal range or whole-current width.
measurement.geographic_scope: Knorr Ajax Leg1 section k at1 E, October1983; band south of primary surface Subtropical Front. Secondary core near39-40 S, not width endpoints.
measurement.section_orientation: Meridional hydrographic section. Source-reported band breadth; no diagnosed local flow-normal axis or paired geographic edges.
measurement.layer: Relative-geostrophic southern component band; Figure5d upper1000 m field and transport context. Exact width evaluation depth unresolved; no uniform depth slab.
measurement.time_convention: October1983, Table1(k). Exact occupation days unknown;1990 is publication, not observation.
measurement.boundary_rule: Source describes a200-km-wide band south of the primary surface front. No explicit numeric velocity edge rule or paired width coordinates. Secondary-core position and offset are separate.
measurement.source_citation: Stramma,L. and R.G.Peterson (1990), The South Atlantic Current, Journal of Physical Oceanography20,846-859.
measurement.source_locator: Original p854 right column; Table1(k) p851, Table2(k) p853, Figure5/caption p855.
measurement.extraction_method: Visual original page review; nominal breadth transcribed. No source curve, flow boundary or uncertainty digitized.
measurement.source_quality_note: One historical band component; primary front carries additional SAC flow. Total-current breadth and secondary-core diameter remain unresolved.

original_regional_context.component_role: Southern SAC transport band south of the primary surface Subtropical Front; excludes the primary-front contribution.
original_regional_context.display_aria_label: South Atlantic Current: authors report a200 km wide southern component band at1 E in October1983. The primary front carries additional SAC flow; total SAC width and secondary-core diameter unknown. Relative geostrophic reference sigma4=45.87 kg/m3 at3470-3560 m. Width depth, edges, exact days and error unknown; no annual range.
original_regional_context.display_caption: October 1983 / Knorr section k at 1 E. Source-reported southern component band breadth; additional SAC flow crosses the primary front. Total-current width unknown.
original_regional_context.display_method_note: 200 km describes the southern band, not the entire SAC or the diameter of its secondary core. The similarly sized core offset is distinct. Width-evaluation depth, edge cutoff, paired geographic boundaries and numerical error remain unknown. No annual or seasonal inference.
